commit: CURRENT.json atomically selects an immutable directory after all payloads are saved and fsynced
tensorflow: No stochastic TensorFlow operations after seeded network initialization; deterministic ops enabled; optimizer/target/online variables persisted
dqn: checkpoint.json including optimizer step count and schedule
identity: routing path and SHA256 must exactly match selection record; checkpoint payload hashes checked
resume: committed slot_index determines next slot; no replay/update/slot duplication; uncommitted interrupted slot work is discarded
static_data: Immutable January empirical request source is reloaded lazily; request RNG is restored, never reseeded on resume
signals: SIGINT/SIGTERM set a stop flag; current main slot completes then commits and exits; failures retain last valid commit
cadence: every8 slots, day boundary, safe stop and completion
writer_lock: nonblocking flock acquired before background spawn, inherited by child; only lock-owning child publishes process.json
